entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: The white-black Ravnican guild of religion, banking and organized crime, where the dead exist as capital and debts bind beyond death.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city where the Orzhov operate.

entities.name: Obzedat
entities.description: The council of ghosts that formerly presided over the Syndicate, taken down by Kaya.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who became Orzhov guildmaster at Bolas's behest, later defected from him and was bound by debt contracts.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: A powerful Orzhov leader who usurped the guild's leadership and returned as a ghost after being murdered.

entities.name: Tomik Vrona
entities.description: An Orzhov advokist who became acting guildmaster through a legal loophole.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker whose invasion Kaya first served, then defected from.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: An Izzet leader and planeswalker who allied with Kaya and Tomik and activated the Interplanar Beacon.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A guildmaster whose murder led to the dissolution of the guild summit.

entities.name: Triumvirate
entities.description: Armin Morov, Slavomir Zoltan and Maladola, who held power in Kaya's absence.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: The Dimir guildmaster aligned with Teysa.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: The one later revealed to have orchestrated the Karlov Manor murders.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker the guildmasters hired Kaya to assassinate as penance.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet leader who convened a meeting of guildmasters after the war; in the Echoverse a spirit dragon who bankrupted the Orzhov.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: The guild Kaya helped Ral engage to conquer a location.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact Bolas brought to Ravnica to trap planeswalkers.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion Ravnica defended against, after which the Orzhov offered exploitative loans.

events.summary: Kaya takes control as Orzhov guildmaster after taking down the Obzedat, at Bolas's behest.
events.quote: Lately, the planeswalker Kaya has taken control as guildmaster of Orzhov after taking down the Obzedat.

events.summary: Kaya raises tithes from 10% to 40% after forgiving debts, causing riots, then lowers them to 18%.
events.quote: Kaya raised Orzhov's existing tithes from 10% to 40% to compensate for the losses caused by forgiving those debts, which quickly led to riots.

events.summary: Kaya and Teysa witness the guild summit's dissolution after Isperia's murder.
events.quote: Kaya and Teysa attended the guild summit on behalf of the Orzhov and witnessed its dissolution after the murder of Isperia .

events.summary: Kaya turns the tables on the hierarchs, has Teysa arrested and offers them a deal.
events.quote: She turned the tables, had Teysa arrested, and offered the hierarchs a deal.

events.summary: Kaya becomes aware of Bolas's treachery and defects from him.
events.quote: At some point, Kaya became aware of Bolas' treacherous nature and defected from him.

events.summary: Once the Beacon is active Bolas brings the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping the planeswalkers.
events.quote: Once the Beacon was active, Bolas brought the Immortal Sun to Ravnica, trapping the planeswalkers there.

events.summary: Orzhov elites reluctantly agree to help Kaya fight Bolas.
events.quote: Despite their disdain for her (due to her policy of forgiving debts and raising taxes), they reluctantly agreed to help her in the fight against Bolas.

events.summary: Power over the Syndicate falls to Teysa and the Triumvirate while Kaya is distracted.
events.quote: With Kaya distracted, the actual power over the Syndicate fell to Matriarch Teysa Karlov and the Triumvirate

events.summary: The guildmasters hire Kaya to assassinate Liliana Vess as penance.
events.quote: The Living Guildpact and the other guildmasters hired Kaya to assassinate Liliana Vess as penance for previously working with Nicol Bolas.

events.summary: Tomik finds a loophole letting Kaya temporarily transfer her contracts and guild duties to him, making him acting guildmaster.
events.quote: However, Tomik Vrona discovered a legal loophole that allowed Kaya to temporarily transfer her Orzhov contracts and guild responsibilities to him.

events.summary: While Kaya fights the Phyrexian invasion, Teysa usurps the guild's leadership.
events.quote: However, while Kaya was fighting in defense of the Multiverse during the New Phyrexian Invasion , Teysa usurped the guild's leadership.

events.summary: After the invasion the Orzhov profit from the disorder with loans at exorbitant interest.
events.quote: However, once the threat was eliminated, they acted quickly to capitalize on the disorder and uncertainty that followed.

events.summary: Teysa is murdered, later revealed as Trostani's work, and returns as a ghost to organize a new ghost council.
events.quote: Teysa was a victim of the murders, later revealed to have been orchestrated by Trostani , but returned as a ghost days later to organize a new ghost council and continue her leadership of the guild.

relations.quote: Lately, the planeswalker Kaya has taken control as guildmaster of Orzhov after taking down the Obzedat.
Lately, the planeswalker Kaya has taken control as guildmaster of Orzhov after taking down the Obzedat.

relations.note: Kaya acted at Bolas's behest before defecting.
relations.quote: She has done this at the behest of Nicol Bolas

relations.note: Kaya joined forces with Ral to prepare for Bolas's invasion.
relations.quote: In preparation for Bolas ' invasion of Ravnica, Kaya joined forces with Ral Zarek .

relations.note: Their close alliance shaped Orzhov largesse to the Izzet.
relations.quote: This generosity was largely influenced by the close alliance between Tomik, a leading Orzhov figure, and Ral Zarek , a prominent Izzet leader.

relations.note: Teysa aligned with the Dimir guildmaster.
relations.quote: Having aligned with the Dimir guildmaster Lazav to gain ultimate power

relations.note: The murders were orchestrated by Trostani.
relations.quote: Teysa was a victim of the murders, later revealed to have been orchestrated by Trostani
